title: Aura Luxe — High-Fashion WooCommerce Store
summary: Full Figma UI design system and bespoke WooCommerce build with dynamic attribute swatches, slide-out cart, and sub-second Ajax product filters.
challenge: The client suffered from an outdated theme with 4.2-second load times and a clunky 5-step checkout process that resulted in a 68% cart abandonment rate.
solution: Architected a minimalist dark-luxury Figma design system, implemented a 1-page checkout funnel, optimized product image pipelines, and built custom ACF product templates.
results: +54% increase in mobile conversion within 30 days
Page load speed reduced from 4.2s to 0.6s (99 Core Web Vitals score)
Cart abandonment dropped by 42% via streamlined slide-out cart

title: NovaVault — B2B Cybersecurity SaaS Site
summary: Enterprise Figma prototype and lightweight Bricks Builder WordPress site featuring interactive pricing calculators and ROI estimation tools.
challenge: Complex enterprise software features were hard to understand for visitors, leading to low demo bookings and high bounce rates on product pages.
solution: Designed interactive visual feature grids, interactive ROI calculators in Figma, and translated them directly into zero-bloat Bricks Builder WordPress modules.
results: +185% boost in enterprise demo booking requests
Seamless client marketing team editing without developer assistance

title: Nexus Studio — Architectural Portfolio & Magazine
summary: Monochrome architectural masterpiece featuring smooth Lenis scrolling, dynamic custom portfolio post types (CPT), and interactive project filter maps.
challenge: High-resolution architectural photography was causing immense lag and poor SEO indexing on their previous Squarespace site.
solution: Created an ultra-modern typography-first Figma UI, implemented next-gen WebP/AVIF automated pipelines in WordPress, and built custom dynamic layout loops.
results: 0.5s DOM Content Loaded time on 4K displays
Ranked #1 on Google for 'Bespoke Luxury Architects New York'
Featured on Awwwards Site of the Day nominee list

title: Lumina Care — Telehealth Platform & Patient Hub
summary: HIPAA-compliant doctor booking system integrated with WordPress Custom Post Types, Calendar sync, and Figma mobile-first UI components.
challenge: Patients struggled to schedule appointments on mobile, causing over 40% abandoned bookings.
solution: Engineered a streamlined 3-step mobile booking funnel in Figma and translated it into a custom WP appointment booking engine.
results: +94% increase in completed online doctor consultations
Zero mobile UI lag with 100% accessible contrast ratios

title: Zenith Roast — Artisan Subscription E-Commerce
summary: Warm terracotta aesthetic e-commerce store with recurring coffee bean subscription builder and custom WooCommerce recurring billing.
challenge: Needed a flexible subscription box builder allowing users to choose bean roast, grind size, and delivery frequency seamlessly.
solution: Created an interactive step-by-step subscription builder in Figma and developed custom WooCommerce subscription logic with custom ACF fields.
results: +310% monthly recurring revenue (MRR) growth in 6 months
Over 12,000 active monthly recurring coffee subscribers

title: Vertex Capital — Financial Advisory & Investment Hub
summary: Sophisticated gold & obsidian corporate portal with secure investor report downloads, ACF options pages, and multi-language WPML setup.
challenge: Outdated corporate website looked untrustworthy to high-net-worth investors and failed mobile security audits.
solution: Redesigned with executive champagne gold accents in Figma and built a secure, encrypted client document download hub in WordPress.
results: +62% increase in high-net-worth inquiry form submissions
Passed ISO 27001 web security audit with 100% compliance
